core_concept: This document outlines a recommended workflow for developing the Odin Project foundation project, emphasizing a structured approach to avoid overwhelm. The advice centers around building the HTML structure first, followed by styling, and encourages iterative commits. It also highlights the importance of deploying the project using GitHub Pages for public viewing.
technical_breakdown: Prioritize incremental development: Break down the project into smaller, manageable sections to reduce complexity.
HTML-First Approach: Build the HTML structure before applying CSS styles to minimize back-and-forth adjustments.
Utilize Existing Knowledge: Leverage previously learned concepts, particularly those from flexbox exercises, for reference.
Focus on Desktop Viewport: The project does not require responsive design implementation for this phase.
